'''Tim Mayers''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[August 1999 Menomonee Falls tournament]] on 12 August 1999 with TIE / SFS odds and [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base numbers]], according to Ryan Fojtik's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d11">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-19-menomonee-falls-wi-8-12-99d11/ menomonee-falls-wi-8-12-99], DeckTech (Ryan "XjedeyeX" Fojtik, 19 August 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-19-menomonee-falls-wi-8-12-99d11/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
